units.title: Make selected outcome leases evolve through durable progress receipts
units.objective: Append strict evidence-bound progress transitions to the existing exact tracker, reconstruct the current selected lease across refresh and sanctioned runtime handoff, and make selected pre-write and causal restart consume that head without changing ordinary claim authority.

included: Strict OutcomeProgressTransitionV1 and operator result contracts
Exact live-claim receipt loading from the selected worktree
Append-only current-head reconstruction and byte-idempotent replay
Stale-parent, duplicate-ID, changed-file, tamper, and foreign-claim denial
Selected pre-write evaluation of the effective scenario and current lease
Causal restart from post-selection stalled or parked evidence
Progress-preserving sanctioned cross-session resume and successor receipt append
Preservation of selection, progress, transfer, and restart custody fields on tracker refresh
One owner-real Plan 119 receipt and selected observation
Focused tests, retained evidence, operator guide, plan body, and work graph
excluded: Project Graph owner or predecessor lookup
Product versus maintenance lease classification or portfolio slot allocation
A second live registry or mutable selected scenario
Cross-worktree, cross-branch, or cross-project successor activation
Installer, fleet propagation, shell interception, deployment, release, or cost controls
Shared plan index and roadmap mutation while another claim owns those paths

outputs: Strict append-only selected-progress transition and result models
Exact progress CLI with current-head lineage enforcement and byte-idempotent replay
Effective selected scenario resolution for pre-write observation and causal restart
Lossless tracker refresh and sanctioned runtime continuation of progress history
Owner-real Plan 119 selected receipt and current-head observation evidence
Focused controls and operator documentation with explicit promotion limits

acceptance.criterion: One strict receipt advances the reconstructed selected lease append-only, and exact accepted file replay returns the retained transition without changing tracker bytes.
evidence_required: Exact receipt file and model digests
Prior and successor lease snapshots and digests
Tracker byte comparison across exact replay
acceptance.negative_control: Stale-parent, duplicate-ID, changed-file, malformed-history, base-receipt replay, or foreign-claim input fails before tracker mutation.

acceptance.criterion: Selected pre-write evaluates the immutable base plus accepted transitions and reports the effective current lease while ordinary claim admission and exit behavior remain authoritative.
evidence_required: Progress transition count and head digest
acceptance.negative_control: An invalid progress history produces a visible observation failure and cannot alter the ordinary decision.

acceptance.criterion: Tracker refresh and sanctioned cross-session resume retain the full progress chain, and the successor runtime can append a receipt against the retained head.
evidence_required: All custody fields before and after tracker refresh
Successor receipt whose parent is the predecessor runtime head
acceptance.negative_control: Unsanctioned identity replacement, transfer tamper, or injected partial transition cannot reset or fork the chain.

acceptance.criterion: Causal restart consumes post-selection stalled or parked evidence and permanently retains that effective predecessor lease and failed receipt refs.
acceptance.negative_control: Restart cannot use the stale selection-time active lease to ignore post-selection failures.

acceptance.criterion: The real Plan 119 claim selects one base scenario, records one authentic behavioral receipt, replays it idempotently, and observes the current head through the ordinary selected pre-write entrypoint.
evidence_required: Exact live claim and tracker refs
Selection, receipt, transition, effective scenario, and lease digests
Ordinary pre-write and selected correlation receipts
Candidate revision and focused command outputs
acceptance.negative_control: Evidence explicitly says observe-only and makes no portfolio, enforcement, independent-review, installer, deployment, or fleet claim.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Plan 118 core is accepted; one exact Plan 119 goal-bound claim owns only the listed current-head contracts, integrations, tests, examples, evidence, guide, plan, and graph paths.

units.title: Reconcile the shared plan index and roadmap after current-head custody is accepted
units.objective: Publish truthful Plan 119 index and roadmap state after executable evidence is accepted and the current shared-path owner releases those files.

included: Add or update the Plan 119 plan-index row
Reconcile the roadmap frontier to Project Graph-bound portfolio admission
excluded: Code, tests, examples, evidence, guide, plan-body, or work-graph behavior changes
Any portfolio-admission or hard-enforcement implementation claim

outputs: Plan 119 index row matching accepted evidence
Roadmap state naming Project Graph-bound product/maintenance portfolio admission as the next frontier

dependencies.rationale: Shared status surfaces must describe accepted behavior rather than anticipated implementation.

acceptance.criterion: The index and roadmap match accepted Plan 119 evidence, retain the observe-only boundary, and name Project Graph binding and explicit lease classes as the next unimplemented prerequisite.
acceptance.negative_control: No portfolio ceiling, hard blocking, independent review, installer, deployment, or fleet completion claim appears.

failed_guards: docs/plans/CLAUDE.md and ROADMAP.md remain owned by plan-110-npw02-blocker-policy

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Claim only after OPRG-01 is accepted and the active Plan 110 owner releases both shared documentation paths.
